claim: On April 28, 2023 the Athena documentation history added documentation for capacity reservations: you can now use capacity reservations on Amazon Athena to run SQL queries on fully-managed compute capacity.
question: Since when does Athena offer capacity reservations (announced as Provisioned Capacity)?

qualifiers.condition: The What's New post of the same day is titled Announcing Provisioned Capacity for Amazon Athena; the pricing page still says Provisioned Capacity in one sentence. Current minimum: athena-capacity-min-4-dpus.
